summary: The ini lookup reads the value of a key in a given section of an INI file, or from a properties file without sections.
questions: How do I read a value from an INI file in Ansible?
Can I read a Java properties file with Ansible?

answer_card.title: ini lookup
answer_card.answer_md: The ini lookup returns the value after `=` for a key in a given `[section]` of an INI file. It can also read properties files, which have no sections.
